GUIDE: Dev Tools --> CSS Overview Tab

Open the dev tools tab with CTRL + SHIFT + J or with the CTRL + SHIFT + I keyboard shortcut in Firefox. Navigate to the css overview tab.

The default panel view has instructions and a Capture overview button. Click the capture overview button. The page is analyzed and a summary is shown relevant of the css elements on the captured page. Below, each section can be observed to inspect and fix recommended css changes.
